meta.trisNote: Conversational front for Cfilms bookings. Answers ONLY from the knowledge base, checks Acuity availability read-only (never books), captures the shoot brief as it learns it, hands to the owner when quote-ready or stuck. Transcript + brief live in the external state store, not model memory. If OmniRoute is unreachable OR returns junk, it hands the live conversation straight to the deterministic qualifier (crea-02) — the two work together, AI leading. 14 nodes: the AI loop plus its real fallback; sub-workflows (wa-send, crea-02) keep the rest decomposed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: '{{CREA_LLM_MODEL}}', temperature: 0.3, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: $json.messages }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ key: $node['Parse AI'].json.from, mode: 'ai', brief: $node['Parse AI'].json.brief, booking_ready: $node['Parse AI'].json.booking_ready, transcript: ($node['Build Prompt'].json.transcript || []).concat([{ role: 'user', content: $node['When called'].json.text }, { role: 'assistant', content: $node['Parse AI'].json.reply }]).slice(-12), lastInboundAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ source: 'whatsapp-ai', from: $node['Parse AI'].json.from, brief: $node['Parse AI'].json.brief, status: $node['Parse AI'].json.booking_ready ? 'to-quote' : 'needs-human', capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

value.text: ={{ ($node['Parse AI'].json.booking_ready ? 'Quote-ready enquiry from ' : 'Needs a human \u2014 ') + $node['Parse AI'].json.from + ':\n' + JSON.stringify($node['Parse AI'].json.brief, null, 2) }}
